name: hdlab/information_foraging.py -- INFORMATION FORAGING organ. Charnov 1976 marginal value theorem in the Constantino & Daw 2015 discrete form (harvest while kappa*s_i >= rho_i*h), with the pinned timed delta rule rho += [1-(1-alpha)^tau]*(r/tau - rho), travel legs updating rho at r=0, rho carrying over and never reset, a LEARNED depletion multiplier kappa, a Wittmann 2016 fast/slow rho pair, and Event-Segmentation-Theory patch boundaries on the consumer's own surprise.
gate_decision_target: notes/ORGAN_MAP.md lists information foraging as one of SEVEN organs MISSING ENTIRELY, and names it as the reason the system cannot notice what it does not know. Substrate-free pure arithmetic over (gain, duration) pairs -- no numpy, no hdlab imports -- so it is unit-testable in milliseconds and reusable by any consumer. Consumed by experiments/exp_information_foraging_reading_v1.py.
witness: verification/test_information_foraging_organ_witness.py (8/8 PASS) + 15 module self-tests, including ONE PER NUMBERED SILENT-FAILURE MODE: travel in rho's denominator; travel updating rho at r=0; expected-next (kappa*s) vs last gain; exact equivalence of the timed delta rule under step-duration regrouping; threshold not fixed; value-not-item-count currency; a source scan of should_leave proving no hand-coded overstay bias; fast/slow rho divergence; document-is-not-a-patch segmentation; and no dACC design warrant.
next_step: The currency fed to it is Bayesian SURPRISE, not Oudeyer LEARNING PROGRESS. Surprise cannot separate learnable novelty from unlearnable noise, so a novelty trap is a live and declared risk; the LP upgrade is the named follow-on.
open_caveats: alpha, beta_leave and travel_step_duration are FREE parameters, declared as such; only the update STRUCTURE is pinned by the literature.

oracle_mvt_optimum was WRONG on first landing (first-crossing stopping, valid only for monotone gain) and reported online/oracle ratios above 1.0 in all four smoke arms; corrected to the Dinkelbach form and regression-tested. Any citation of an oracle ratio must be from commit 0ab865798 or later.

name: hdlab/perirhinal_conjunctive.py
gate_decision_target: Landed DEFAULT-OFF and MEASURED on the real task in the same session. exp_perirhinal_conjunctive_readout_c3_v1 (full, n=4000, 5491 anchors, elapsed 587s): all three conjunctive arms FAILED their own pre-registered known-answer gate (self-retrieval 0.6823 / 0.6990 / 0.6622 vs floor 0.70; base 0.7860 passed) and all three are CI-separated BELOW the flat bag (-0.0165 / -0.0095 / -0.0145, every CI excluding zero and exceeding the projection-draw sd). SHELVE, not delete: the organ is correct, cheap and witnessed; it is the TASK that does not want it.
revival_criteria: BRAIN-FRAMED (corrected 2026-08-16; SUPERSEDES a performance-framed criterion -- see below). Conjunctive coding is NOT TESTABLE until PATTERN COMPLETION (hippocampal CA3, recurrent auto-association) sits in front of it. Separation (dentate gyrus) and completion (CA3) are a MATCHED PAIR: the brain NEVER retrieves with an exact key, it COMPLETES a stored pattern from a PARTIAL CUE, and a conjunctive code's entire benefit -- disambiguating overlapping feature sets that a flat sum collapses -- is only expressible THROUGH a completion step. Measured without one, a conjunctive code is being asked to do a job its partner organ does. REVIVE WHEN: a CA3-style pattern-completion stage exists and can be placed in front of this code; then re-run the pre-registered known-answer self-retrieval arm (gate 0.70; it measured 0.6823 / 0.6990 / 0.6622 with NO completion stage present) alongside the open-vocab read-out. The banked isolation win (conjunctive 1.000 vs additive 0.273) stands and is exactly what makes the DG/CA3 pairing worth building. REJECTED PRIOR CRITERION, recorded so the error is not repeated: 'Revive ONLY for a task whose QUERY IS THE STORED KEY (exact-key facet addressing, conflict retrieval, episodic recall).' That is a PERFORMANCE-ENGINEERING frame in a brain-fidelity project. It named the regime where the organ happens to score well instead of the organ that is MISSING, and would have shelved a correct, witnessed component for the wrong reason while hiding the real gap (there is no CA3 completion stage anywhere in the substrate). A wrong frame closes a live research direction. (USER standing directive 2026-08-15: 'we need to be doing brain foundational things - not maximizing performance in single areas.')
current_best_for: NOTHING ON THE LIVE PATH TODAY. Retained as the measured, witnessed reference implementation of a conjunctive context code: P = sum_{i<j} phi_i*phi_j = (S*S - m)/2 exactly, an elementwise quadratic of the live bag costing O(m*d).
provenance: hdi_exp_dev Wall-2 dispatch 2026-08-15. Organ self-tests 6/6 (incl. bit-exact identity vs an explicit O(m^2) double loop); witness verify_perirhinal_conjunctive_default_off.py PASS 4/4 asserting the live default path is BIT-IDENTICAL with the organ imported and the switch False. Pre-reg preregs/2026-08-15_exp_perirhinal_conjunctive_readout_c3_v1.md written before any arm was scored; it pre-declared (P3) that the most likely outcome was no conjunctive arm clearing base and that this would be reported plainly with no rescue tuning. It was, and it was.
brain_structure: Perirhinal cortex -- feature-CONJUNCTION coding in the MTL ventral ('what') stream, the structure that exists to resolve exactly the feature-ambiguity case a flat sum fails. Its MATCHED PARTNER organs are hippocampal CA3 (recurrent pattern COMPLETION from a partial cue) with dentate gyrus (pattern SEPARATION) upstream: DG separates, CA3 completes, perirhinal supplies the conjunctive code they operate over. Only the perirhinal half is built.
fidelity_basis_note: SPLIT, stated honestly rather than rounded up to 'pinned': the ORGAN is pinned by evidence (perirhinal conjunctive coding is an established neuroscience finding, and the DG-separate / CA3-complete pairing is textbook). The specific ENCODING OPERATION we implemented -- P = sum_{i<j} phi_i*phi_j = (S*S - m)/2, an elementwise quadratic of the live bag -- is OUR INVENTION standing in for conjunctive coding; no source pins that algebraic form to perirhinal cortex. Invention is authorised; presenting it as pinned is not. Hence invention_under_test.

name: hdlab/hub_spoke_word.py
gate_decision_target: NOT WIRED and NOT SHELVED, and both halves of that are deliberate. Measured at FULL in exp_hub_spoke_word_representation_v1 (V=4096, d in {1024,256}, seeds {7,17,23}, instrument validity 12/12, verdict PARTIAL) and exp_hub_spoke_partial_cue_curve_v1 (instrument validity 8/8, verdict ADDRESSING_HOLDS_UNDER_PARTIAL_CUE). WHAT IT HAS EARNED, stated at its true strength and no higher: (1) it is a CONSTRUCTION PROOF -- facet recovery 1.0000 vs a flat sum at 0.2483 (chance 0.25) is role binding recovering its own role, i.e. ALGEBRA, and the cell's own gate says so; (2) the extension property holds at full scale -- adding a fifth spoke leaves the four existing keys BIT-IDENTICAL and every already-written word vector still answers identically (G2 true on all 6 configs); (3) it does NOT inherit the conjunctive collapse under a partial cue -- at 20% content overlap the conjunctive operator is CI-separated below the flat bag (-0.0247, CI [-0.0371,-0.0127]) while this code TIES it (-0.0007, CI [-0.0160,+0.0147]), and the collapse control fires in the same run on the same words, so the instrument demonstrably can detect one. WHAT BLOCKS A WIRE DECISION: it does not BEAT the flat bag anywhere measured. Its pre-registered headline gate G1 FAILED at full (F_SCRAMBLE scores 1.0000 on the facet axis, identical to the treatment arm, and so does N_NULLCONTENT). G3 MEANING FAILED, band NOT_SEPARATED (margin 0.1083 over the hardened frequency floor, CI [-0.0380,+0.2563]), and on SimLex the UNADDRESSED flat sum (0.1967) matches or slightly beats the addressed bundle (0.1913) -- unbinding by a bipolar key is an ISOMETRY, so it buys an address, never extra geometry. NO MEANING CLAIM IS LICENSED BY ANY NUMBER IN THESE CELLS, and nothing here touches the 4.80% read-out. WHAT WOULD DECIDE IT: the storage instrument (notes/PLAN.md ITEM 1) exists and this code is CI-separated above the flat-sum arm on addressability, on the identical scorer/n/pool/gold, with key sensitivity >= 0.15 -- the ITEM 4 floor, unchanged and not restated more weakly here. DISSENT RECORDED: the cell author recommended WIRE (.claude/scan-out/wall1-hubspoke-full.json, OUTSTANDING_FOR_THE_OWNER). The audit role declined to record WIRE because no measured axis beats the flat bag, and declined to record SHELVE because that would close a live direction the plan is actively sequencing. A WIRE decision is the owner's or the Director's to make, not the auditor's.
revival_criteria: BRAIN-FRAMED, per PLAN R13. If this code is ever set aside, the criterion is NOT 'revive when it scores higher'. The structure is the anterior temporal lobe semantic hub with modality spokes, and the open brain question about it is not performance -- it is the MISSING COMPLETER. Hippocampal CA3 recurrent collaterals complete a stored pattern from a PARTIAL CUE; dentate-gyrus separation and CA3 completion are a MATCHED PAIR; we own the separating half (hdlab/dg_pattern_separation.py, zero importers) and have never built the completing half. This code was measured with NO completion stage in front of it, which is the current substrate and not the brain. REVIVE / RE-MEASURE WHEN: a CA3-style completion stage exists and can sit between the query and the code; then re-run the partial-cue curve and the storage-instrument addressability arm with it in place. SECOND, INDEPENDENT BRAIN QUESTION, recorded so it is not lost: the code's meaning content is entirely the SENSORIMOTOR-NORM ASSET it is built from (cleanup is near-perfect at code-exact 0.94, so the rescored G3 lands ON the direct-spoke-code ceiling at 0.19768 vs 0.19773). A spoke made of text-derived norms is not evidence that the hub-and-spoke ARCHITECTURE is wrong when the SPOKE carries no separable meaning; those two must be judged separately.
current_best_for: NOTHING ON THE LIVE PATH TODAY. It is the reference implementation of a word as ONE vector whose facets stay separately askable: word_vector(w) = Q(SUM_s bind(SPOKE_KEY[s], spoke_code_s(w))), ask_for(w,s) = unbind(w, SPOKE_KEY[s]), with spoke_key derived from blake2b(seed||spoke_name) and nothing else -- which is what makes a spoke addable later without invalidating a single already-written vector. It is the substrate for notes/PLAN.md ITEM 4 (spokes versus one flat sum). Its binding primitives are the numpy twins of hdlab.role_slot_summarizer's validated torch primitives and equality with EventBundleCodec.encode_event is ASSERTED by selftest_reuse_is_bit_identical(), not claimed in prose.
provenance: Registered 2026-08-16 by the audit role (hdi_skunkworks, AUDIT-ONLY: it did not author, run or dispatch any cell in this row). Every number in this row was recomputed off disk from data/exp_hub_spoke_word_representation_v1/metrics.json and data/exp_hub_spoke_partial_cue_curve_v1/metrics.json with .venv python, never taken from a verdict report: the paired deltas were re-derived as a 3-seed mean at d=256 from the per-unit CURVE_B_paired_delta_vs_FLAT blocks, and the per-arm facet recoveries (F_SCRAMBLE 1.0000 CI [1.0000,1.0000], N_NULLCONTENT 1.0000, FLAT_SUM 0.2483) were re-derived from the parent cell's units. Module self-tests: selftest_reuse_is_bit_identical(), selftest_extension_does_not_invalidate(). Cell-side assertions the runs abort on: PV3 (bit-identity of the partial-cue read-out at full cue against the parent's own facet_recovery), PV6 (conjunction bit-identical to hdlab/perirhinal_conjunctive), PV7 (arms must differ, which caught a real degenerate-scramble bug before any data run). GAP DISCLOSED: there is NO verification/ witness for this module -- unlike perirhinal_conjunctive, which has verify_perirhinal_conjunctive_default_off.py. used_by above is a STATIC grep of experiments/, NOT a runtime import closure (PLAN R9); the runtime claim being made here is only the negative one -- it is absent from the live 40-module closure.
brain_structure: Anterior temporal lobe (ATL) semantic hub plus modality spokes in sensory and motor cortex, with word FORM handled separately by the visual word form area (left fusiform / occipitotemporal). The pinned fact is the DOUBLE DISSOCIATION: ATL hub damage degrades meaning across all modalities at once, whereas focal spoke damage produces modality-or-category-specific loss with the rest intact. A single blended store predicts only the first pattern, which is why 'each piece keeps its own address' is the architectural claim under test. MATCHED PARTNER ORGAN NOT BUILT: hippocampal CA3 recurrent collaterals (completion from a partial cue), whose separating partner (dentate gyrus, hdlab/dg_pattern_separation.py) we own with zero importers.
fidelity_basis_note: SPLIT, stated honestly rather than rounded up to 'pinned'. PINNED-BY-EVIDENCE: that word form and word meaning are separate brain systems tied by an anterior-temporal hub, and that each piece keeps its own address (the double dissociation above). OUR-INVENTION-BEING-TESTED: implementing 'ask for one facet' as unbind-by-role-key, i.e. elementwise bipolar bind. NO source pins circular convolution or elementwise multiplication to the ATL, and we do not claim the brain performs it. This matches the tag the module's own docstring and notes/PLAN.md section 5 already carry for the same choice, so the registry does not disagree with the plan. Also ours, and also not a brain fact: the operationalisation of 'partial cue' as dimension-wise substitution from a different item, and degrading each spoke independently.

evidence_per_dimension.D1: Anterior temporal hub + modality spokes, with the DOUBLE DISSOCIATION as the documented computation a single blended store cannot predict (Rogers, Lambon Ralph, Garrard, Bozeat, McClelland, Hodges & Patterson 2004 Psychol Rev 111:205-235, via notes/ORGAN_MAP.md B2; PLAN sec 5 anchor 2).

brain_fidelity_score.WHAT_THIS_CANNOT_DO: Measures fidelity, NOT capability. A high-fidelity component can lose and a low-fidelity one can win -- both are in our own retrodiction. It can never clear, soften or substitute for the floor-and-CI bar (PLAN R1).

evidence_per_dimension.D1: A NEURAL SYSTEM is named, not a cognitive-theory label: modality-specific sensory and motor cortex feeding the anterior temporal lobe hub (hub-and-spoke; notes/ORGAN_MAP.md B5). Two hard results bound it -- left dorsal ATL represents object-colour knowledge in congenitally blind and sighted alike, so a sensory-independent code coexists (Wang, Men, Gao, Caramazza & Bi 2020 Neuron 107:383-393); and text-only channels recover non-sensorimotor meaning well, sensory poorly, motor minimally (Xu et al. 2025 Nat Hum Behav).
evidence_per_dimension.D2: THE HUB-SPOKE COMBINATION RULE IS UNPINNED -- notes/ORGAN_MAP.md B5 states it explicitly, and there is no equation for how spoke evidence combines with the hub's. Our operation, 'the candidate nearest in spoke space is the meaning', is OUR INVENTION and is labelled so in the module docstring and in the registry row. SHAPE: a 12-dim z-scored rating profile is not a cortical population code. POSITION: it sits at meaning selection, which is where a spoke would feed, but it feeds a scoring cell rather than the hub. METRIC: no pinned metric exists, and ours was SWEPT (euclid and cosine) rather than chosen -- the pre-registered euclid was then refuted on the instrument.
evidence_per_dimension.D3: The hub regime is pinned DENSE AND GRADED (~4 group PCs, Huth 2012 Neuron 76:1210, via notes/ORGAN_MAP.md B4). Our profiles ARE dense and graded, which matches. But the SELECTION is a hard nearest-neighbour argmax, where the brain implements graded competition through the normalisation pool rather than a hard argmax (Carandini & Heeger 2012, via ORGAN_MAP C2). Dense/graded MATCHES; graded-vs-binary readout DIVERGES.
evidence_per_dimension.D5: The matched partner is the ANTERIOR TEMPORAL HUB, and the hub-plus-spokes pairing is pinned by the DOUBLE DISSOCIATION (Rogers, Lambon Ralph, Garrard, Bozeat, McClelland, Hodges & Patterson 2004, Psychol Rev 111:205-235): a single blended store cannot predict the pattern, so both members must be present and connected. Scored 0 because that connection does not exist in our system -- see detail. The biological claim is Rogers et al.; the fact that we fail it is an audit fact and is kept out of the evidence field on purpose.
evidence_per_dimension.D6: NO DEGRADATION CURVE HAS BEEN MEASURED for this organ. The shuffled-norms control shows the arm collapses when profiles are permuted (0.0639 -> 0.0206 pooled, p<0.05 every seed), which proves the norms carry it but is a DESTRUCTION test, not a graceful-degradation curve. Biological systems degrade gracefully under partial cues; nothing here has been measured across a cue-degradation ladder. Scored 0 because there is no citable basis, per the tool's own rule that a dimension with no basis scores 0 and never a default middle value.

name: Salience binder -- ACT-R base-level activation + Centering grammatical prominence (pronoun BIND); Nref graded write (divisive normalization, reuses graded_competition softmax)

Keep BINDING salience-based and PREDICTION content-addressable (the dissociation) -- do NOT cross the channels. Wire the composed readout for RETRIEVAL ('what did X do'), NOT as an entity-conditioned predictive prior on running narrative (measured null). MEASURE on the live reader before any capability claim. Off-path/ISLAND (consolidation composition target).
brain_structure: ACT-R base-level activation (Anderson & Schooler 1991; ACT-R declarative retrieval): B = ln sum_k w(role_k)*dt_k^-decay -- a log-sum of power-law-decayed prominence-weighted past mentions. Grammatical prominence = Centering theory Cf-ranking (SUBJECT>POSSESSIVE>OBJECT>OTHER). On HARD same-gender ambiguous pronouns RECENCY is at CHANCE -> prominence is load-bearing; binding is structural/salience, NOT semantic (implicit-causality does not replicate). The graded WRITE is divisive normalization (Carandini & Heeger 2012; the Nref 'hold candidates open under WM load'): softmax(activation/temp), an INTERIOR optimum (peak temp~2.0; both winner-take-all and uniform worse). ONE operation reused: the write softmax IS the parser's role-competition softmax (Lewis & Vasishth 2005 cue-based retrieval is itself an ACT-R model) -> reuses hdlab.graded_competition.softmax (gain=1/temp). Dissociation: BIND by salience (this organ), PREDICT by content-addressable retrieval (a different channel).

name: Incremental left-corner argument-structure builder -- eager verb-slot projection, bounded Now-or-Never buffer; the STRUCTURAL front-end (beats the batch UD parse +0.0352 F1 via precision)

Wire as the CANDIDATE SOURCE behind a flag; the role assigner labels the candidates (keep structure-building and role-binding SEPARATE, Beber 2025); prediction ON (predictive_reader selectional preference for competing post-verbal nominals), revision OFF (default; garden-path reanalysis only when forced); route reversibles to the relcl filler-gap resolver. Expect a PRECISION gain (batch over-generates +1.03 args/predicate). MEASURE on the live reader before any capability claim. Off-path/ISLAND (consolidation composition target).
brain_structure: Incremental left-to-right processing under the NOW-OR-NEVER bottleneck (Christiansen & Chater 2016): commit as each word arrives, bounded lossy buffer. LEFT-CORNER projection: eager bottom-up bind of the nearest preceding buffered nominal as subject; eager post-verbal patient fill (Ferreira/Frazier 'good-enough' bounded attachment). Prediction (optional): verb->PATIENT selectional-preference fit resolves competing post-verbal nominals (predictive_reader). Revision (optional, default-off): NP/S garden-path reanalysis on a two-route conflict (brain-faithful -- garden-path +0.0852 CI-sep zero false-fire -- but hurts clean prose, so off unless forced). Structure-BUILDING (this organ) and role-BINDING (the role assigner) are SEPARATE organs (Beber 2025 double dissociation: frontal/pMTG vs posterior-temporal/angular). The discrete eager decision is the noise->0 limit of graded cue-based competition (graded_competition).

name: Relative-clause filler-gap resolver -- active-filler object-gap detection over UPOS + closed-class relativizers (reversible-sentence role assignment, NO arc graph)
gate_decision_target: Reversible-sentence role assignment: when word order underdetermines who-did-what ('the doctor that the lawyer chased'), bind the fronted filler as the PATIENT via the active-filler object-gap rule. Wire as the reversible-case route AFTER the role assigner; route to it only when the object-gap gate fires -- OR expose the two competing scorers + a conflict term (NOT if/else) so the route-CONFLICT is a gold-free difficulty signal. Route AROUND the arc parser (measurably HARMFUL here). Leaves canonical clauses untouched (net-positive gate). Value is CORRECTNESS on the rare hard sentences a situation model needs (~0.75% of text), not an aggregate headline. MEASURE on the live reader. Off-path/ISLAND (consolidation composition target).
brain_structure: The ACTIVE-FILLER strategy (Frazier & Flores d'Arcais 1989; Clifton & Frazier): posit an object GAP as soon as licensed -- a relative-clause verb takes the fronted antecedent as PATIENT exactly when the object slot is empty (gap) and a subject nominal intervenes (subject filled). Glass-box over UPOS + closed-class relativizers ({that,which,who,whom}); the relativizer must be ATTACHED (preceding token a nominal antecedent), ruling out the complementizer 'that' and interrogatives; NO dependency graph. The discrete rule is the noise->0 competence limit of graded additive cue-based content-addressable RETRIEVAL (Lewis & Vasishth 2005; McElree 2000; Dotlacil 2021) -- the SAME retrieval/competition primitive as graded_competition and the episodic store. Reversible role binding localises to POSTERIOR-TEMPORAL / pMTG / inferior-parietal (Beber 2025; Matchin & Hickok 2020), NOT a BA44 'movement' operator.
